Several commuters walk down ahead of me. OBJECTS: Commuters descending ahead including a woman in an off-shoulder black top and plaid wide trousers, a man in a black t-shirt carrying a large black duffel bag in his right hand, a person in a white top pulling a white rolling suitcase, and several other passengers ahead; yellow directional arrow stickers and triangular warning signs ('小心梯級 Mind your step') posted on both mosaic walls; my own grey sweatpants XXX at the bottom of the frame. SCREEN CONTENT: No electronic screens XXX yet. TEXT IN THE WORLD: '小心梯級 Mind your step' on wall safety warning stickers. MEDIA PLAYING: None. AMBIENT AUDIO: Echoing footsteps and station murmurs, accompanied by an ongoing station PA/XXX announcement: '正向站立时，请注意安全。请不要和别人发生冲突。大家请不要在门口、楼梯、走廊、左右两边站定定，唔好再行啊！要时刻照顾旁边那些独走朋友啊！'

The left wall is lined with light-purple curved ceramic panels fitted with large backlit advertising lightboxes. The vaulted ceiling features curved white acoustic panels with bright indirect recessed lighting, alongside exposed overhead utility trays and metal ventilation grilles. To the right, stainless steel railings with clear glass panels partition the passenger walkway from the fare-paid concourse area. In the distance, several commuters walk along the hallway, and the circular illuminated Customer Service Centre (客務中心) is XXX ahead. Objects: Large backlit billboard for Hengqin Chimelong Resort on the left wall; tactile paving along the floor; stainless steel glass guardrails on the right; wall-mounted utility access doors and fire equipment panels; overhead black-and-white direction signs.
